    The Boston Red Sox vs. Cincinnati Reds game on Saturday, March 28, 2026, at 4:10 p.m. ET is available on
    NESN (Red Sox local) and Reds.TV (Reds local), with live streaming on Fubo (free trial) and NESN 360. Out-of-market viewers can use MLB.TV. 
    TV Channels & Streaming Options 
    • Locally (Boston/NESN Region): NESN, NESN 360.
    • Locally (Cincinnati Region): Reds.TV, Spectrum Cable.
    • Streaming Services: Fubo (offers free trial) carries both local, in-market channels, making it a primary option.
    • Out of Market: MLB.TV. 
    Game Time 
    • Date: Saturday, March 28, 2026.
    • Time: 4:10 p.m. ET.
    • Location: Great American Ball Park, Cincinnati, Ohio. 
    Make sure to check Fubo's coverage area for local, in-market access to NESN or Reds.TV.

    How to get MLB.TV for free?

    AI Overview
    The best way to get MLB.TV for free in 2026 is through the T-Mobile Tuesdays app, which offers a free yearly subscription to eligible subscribers. This promotion is available from March 24 through March 31, 2026, and is available for T-Mobile, Metro, and Home Internet customers. Other options include a 30-day free trial through Walmart+. 
    This video shows you how to redeem the free MLB.TV subscription if you are a T-Mobile user:
    53s
    Victoria Daisy
    YouTube · Mar 24, 2026
    Key Ways to Access Free MLB.TV:
    • T-Mobile/Metro by T-Mobile:
      Eligible customers can claim a free full-season subscription (a
      ≈$150is approximately equal to $ 150
      value) via the T-Mobile Tuesdays app.             This includes out-of-market games,, MLB Big Inning, and audio for all teams. 
    • Walmart+:
      A 30-day free trial of Walmart+ may offer access to services featuring free baseball content. 
    • Free MLB App Access:
      The MLB App includes select free content and, if you already have a subscription through another provider (like a TV package), you can link it for free, according to this MLB page. 
    • Watch Free Games:
      The MLB app regularly offers one "Free Game of the Day," though this requires no subscription, it is not full access, as noted in this Mashable article. 
    Important Limitations:
    • Blackouts:
      The free T-Mobile subscription does not remove in-market blackout restrictions, meaning you cannot watch your local team's games live, says this CNET article. 
    • Deadline:
      T-Mobile users must redeem the offer before 4:59 AM ET on March 31, 2026, to avoid missing out, according to this Engadget article.

      AI Overview
      For the 2026 season, watch Cincinnati Reds games in-market via the new REDS.TV app ($19.99/mo or $99.99/season), or through providers like Altafiber, Spectrum, and Xfinity. FuboTV is another option, while national games may appear on FOX or Apple TV+. Out-of-market viewers should use MLB.TV. 
      How to Watch Today (March 28, 2026):
      • In-Market: Check for the game on the REDS.TV app or your local channel finder (via cable/satellite). 
      • Alternative: Select games may air on local TV (such as WXIX FOX 19). 
      • Out-of-Market: Watch on the MLB.TV app. 
      REDS.TV has replaced FanDuel Sports Network, providing in-market access without blackouts.
